messages:
ReleaseBot: :rocket: Deploy kickoff: rolling rollout planned (US -> EU -> APAC). Artifact: rwd-inference@v2.3.1. Target slices: US 10%, EU 10% (adjustable), APAC 5% (HOLD as needed). Change window: Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary rules: 3m observation, auto-fallback to pinned model on SLA breach.

ReleaseBot: rollout CLI (example):
```
rwdctl deploy --artifact rwd-inference@v2.3.1 \
  --regions us:10,europe:10,apac:5 \
  --canary-window 3m \
  --auto-fallback=true
```

Maria: holding on APAC till ops confirms headroom + thermal. pinging @OpsBot.

OpsBot: capacity snapshot (now): US headroom=28% (ok), EU headroom=14% (tight), APAC headroom=6% (low). APAC rack temps: average=73C, recent spike to 79.2C on rack-az3-db-cache. Recommendation: DO NOT start APAC slice until cooling cleared.

Ajay: if APAC needs softer footprint we can reduce `batch_size` 32->16 and `prefetch` 4->2 for APAC only. That should free VRAM and lower p99. Thoughts?

Kai: agree with Ajay. Also suggest pin APAC to stable model v2.3.0 and set fallback policy to v2.3.0 if latency >350ms for 3m. That avoids unfamiliar regressions in low-headroom region.

ReleaseBot: pin command example:
```
rwdctl rollout --region apac --pin model:v2.3.0 \
  --fallback model:v2.3.0 \
  --metric latency_threshold=350ms --window=3m
```

Sam: EU looks flaky this morning (queue depth spike at 07:12 UTC). Can we reduce EU canary to 5% until we validate infra? @Devon please confirm.

Devon: ok to reduce EU to 5% and hold APAC. Rollback triggers: error_rate >1% (3m) or latency increase >20% (5m) => immediate rollback to previous stable. Pager on for rollout window.

Lia: customer-facing note: No planned downtime. APAC may see routing to nearby region if we hold. I'll draft an announcement after we finalize the hold/pin.

Maria: Ops, action items: 1) reduce APAC batch_size if possible, 2) pin APAC to v2.3.0 with fallback, 3) run smoke tests post-pin.

OpsBot: smoke run queued. Expected ~5m. Abort conditions: any GPU temp >78C OR headroom <5% OR error_rate >0.8% during smoke.

ReleaseBot: Canary progress: US -> starting 10% (nodes warming), EU -> deploying at 5% (reduced per Dev), APAC -> HOLD (pending ops). Logs: US warm 30% nodes, EU warm 12%.

Ajay: note for runbook: if abort, auto-rollback to v2.3.0 must be immediate and circuit should pin traffic to fallback region until we have cleared APAC. Make sure alert has stacktrace link.

Devon: pager subscription confirmed. Enabling trace sampling 1% for this window so we can triage regressions faster.

ReleaseBot: smoke complete: US OK (p50/p95 stable), EU p99 up 8% (within thresholds). APAC not started.

OpsBot: smoke summary detail: US headroom stable, GPU temps nominal (65-70C). EU saw IO burst but stabilized. APAC: rack-az3-db-cache temp spike to 79.2C; cooling team engaged, ETA ~30m for clearance. Holding APAC.

Maria: :thumbsup: Holding APAC. Reconvene in 30m for final go/no-go. Lia, prep short customer message: one-line update + expected decision time.

Lia: will post to #announcements once we have final green. Draft: "Planned platform improvements deploying now for US/EU. APAC rollout is paused pending localized cooling check; no customer impact expected—traffic remains routed as usual. ETA update in 30m."

ReleaseBot: saved rollout state and pinned apac to v2.3.0 as requested. Will await ops clearance to proceed.

Maria: thanks everyone. If cooling clears early and smoke passes, we'll start APAC at reduced slice (3-5%) with batch_size=16 and full fallback policy.

OpsBot: update in 28m or earlier.

Devon: adding a post-mortem template to the runbook in case we hit rollback: keep short, include metrics snapshot and commit hash.

Maria: copy. Closing thread for now, we'll reopen here after ops update. :white_check_mark:
